content.text: Hello everyone and welcome back to EnglishPod. My name is Marco.
content.trans: 大家好，欢迎回到 EnglishPod。我是 Marco。

content.text: And my name is Catherine. So Marco, what are we talking about here today?
content.trans: 我是 Catherine。Marco，今天我们要聊些什么？

content.text: Today we're going shopping again.
content.trans: 今天我们又要去购物了。

content.text: We go shopping a lot here in EnglishPod but this is an upper intermediate level lesson
content.trans: 我们在 EnglishPod 经常购物，但这这是一节中高级水平的课程，

content.text: so we've got some very specific terminology to cover.
content.trans: 所以我们会涉及一些非常具体的术语。

content.text: Exactly. We're going shopping for a digital camera so we're going to be talking about very specific,
content.trans: 没错。我们要去买数码相机，所以我们会谈论非常具体的、

content.text: maybe a little bit technical vocab related to this very fascinating and expensive product.
content.trans: 也许有点技术性的词汇，跟这个既迷人又昂贵的产品有关。

content.text: Alright, I'm very excited. I recently purchased a camera but we won't talk about that yet.
content.trans: 好的，我很兴奋。我最近也买了一台相机，不过我们先不聊那个。

content.text: Let's take a listen to the dialogue for the first time and when we come back

content.text: we can talk about some of the really interesting details.

content.text: Hello, Ma'am. Can I help you find something?
content.trans: 您好女士，需要帮忙找什么吗？

content.text: Yes, actually, I'm looking to buy a camera.
content.trans: 是的，我想买一台相机。

content.text: We've got a wide selection. Do you know if you'd like a point and shoot or something a little fancier?
content.trans: 我们有很多选择。您是想要傻瓜相机（卡片机），还是稍微高级一点的？

content.text: Are you shopping for yourself or for someone else?
content.trans: 您是给自己买还是给别人买？

content.text: Actually, I'm buying a camera for my husband.
content.trans: 实际上，我是给我丈夫买的。

content.text: Ah, well then I'd recommend a nice entry level digital SLR.
content.trans: 啊，那样的话，我推荐一款不错的入门级数码单反相机。

content.text: Yeah, can I take a look at the SLRs you carry?
content.trans: 好啊，能让我看看你们有哪些单反吗？

content.text: Sure thing, follow me. This here is a little...
content.trans: 没问题，跟我来。这台是小巧的……

content.text: The Canon EOS. Yeah, it's okay but I'm looking for something that performs better in low light.
content.trans: 佳能 EOS。嗯，这台还可以，但我想找一台在弱光环境下表现更好的。

content.text: Has a better display panel and longer battery life.
content.trans: 有更好的显示屏，电池续航也要更长。

content.text: Oh, the Nikon D60 is a nice option.
content.trans: 噢，那尼康 D60 是个不错的选择。

content.text: Yeah, but what kit lens does this camera come with?
content.trans: 是挺好，但这台相机配的是什么套机镜头？

content.text: I don't want some bulky telephoto lens.
content.trans: 我不想要那种笨重的长焦镜头。

content.text: Ah, well this one has the...
content.trans: 啊，这台配的是……

content.text: Looks to me like an 18 to 55mm lens.
content.trans: 我看像是一个 18 到 55 毫米的镜头。

content.text: Pretty standard.
content.trans: 很标准。

content.text: A little bit.
content.trans: 是有点。

content.text: Not like my husband will be stalking celebrities or anything.
content.trans: 反正我丈夫又不会去跟踪偷拍明星什么的。

content.text: So, can I interest you in any accessories?
content.trans: 那，您对配件感兴趣吗？

content.text: Do you carry polarizing filters?
content.trans: 你们有偏振镜吗？

content.text: Polarizing filters.
content.trans: 偏振镜……

content.text: Um, we should.
content.trans: 呃，应该有。

content.text: I'm sorry ma'am, looks like we're sold out.
content.trans: 抱歉女士，好像卖光了。

content.text: No you're not. There's some right here.
content.trans: 不，没卖光。这儿不就是吗。

content.text: Oh well, would you look at that.
content.trans: 噢，哎哟，你瞧瞧。

content.text: Polarizing filters.
content.trans: 还真是偏振镜。

content.text: Thanks for your help.
content.trans: 谢谢你的“帮助”。

content.text: Ralph.
content.trans: 拉尔夫

content.text: No problem ma'am.
content.trans: 没问题女士。

content.text: Alright, we're back.
content.trans: 好的，我们回来了。

content.text: So apparently this girl knew more than the salesman about these things.
content.trans: 很显然，这个女孩比销售员更懂行。

content.text: Is this from a little life experience?
content.trans: 这是你的亲身经历吗？

content.text: Maybe.
content.trans: 也许吧。

content.text: Maybe.
content.trans: 也许。

content.text: Well, we can get to that later like I said.
content.trans: 好吧，我们一会再聊这个。

content.text: But there are some very important words that anyone who wants to buy a camera should know
content.trans: 但如果你想买相机，有一些非常重要的词你应该知道，

content.text: before they go into the store.
content.trans: 在你进店之前。

content.text: And these are common across the board.
content.trans: 这些词是很通用的。

content.text: So, let's take a look at these in today's language takeaway.
content.trans: 那么，让我们在今天的语言要点里看看这些词。

content.text: Language takeaway.
content.trans: 语言要点。

content.text: Alright, so in language takeaway today we have our first difference.
content.trans: 好的，今天的语言要点我们先看第一个区别。

content.text: Now, it's very important to know the difference between point and shoot camera and the digital SLR.
content.trans: 现在，了解点和拍相机和数码单反之间的区别非常重要。

content.text: Okay, so digital, everyone knows digital now, right?
content.trans: Digital（数码），大家现在都知道什么是数码了，对吧？

content.text: That's the kind of photography we have.
content.trans: 这是我们现在的摄影方式。

content.text: You don't use film.
content.trans: 不使用胶卷。

content.text: Okay, use the memory card to record digital images.
content.trans: 用存储卡来记录数字图像。

content.text: Point and shoot are those little cameras where you just click and it takes a picture.
content.trans: 快门是那些只需要点击就能拍摄照片的小相机。

content.text: There's no lens, there's no additional lens, there's no special add-ons.
content.trans: 没有（可更换）镜头，没有额外的镜头，没有特殊的配件。

content.text: It's a small rectangle and you just take normal pictures.
content.trans: 它就是一个小长方块，你就拍普通的照片。

content.text: And that's the kind of camera that like my mom uses.
content.trans: 这就像是我妈妈用的那种相机。

content.text: Make everyone use it.
content.trans: 很多人都用。

content.text: I have it in my purse and whatever.
content.trans: 我包里就放着一个。

content.text: Yeah.
content.trans: 是的。

content.text: It's easy to use.
content.trans: 很容易使用。

content.text: But the digital SLR is a kind of camera that's like the oldest SLR where you have an attachment of a body and you have a lens.
content.trans: 但数码单反（digital SLR）就像老式的单反相机，你有机身和镜头。

content.text: And they're just much fancier and you have to do a lot more on your own to make a nice picture.
content.trans: 它们更高级，你需要自己做更多操作才能拍出好照片。

content.text: Now SLR, that's an acronym, do you know what it stands for?
content.trans: SLR 是一个缩写，你知道它代表什么吗？

content.text: So an SLR is a single lens reflex camera and that means that there's a lot more you have to do as the photographer to make sure that the picture comes out well.
content.trans: 所以，SLR（单反）相机是一个单镜头反光相机，这意味着作为摄影师，您需要做很多事情才能确保照片拍得不错。

content.text: Right, so it's really interesting because you can actually play with the lens like the focus and you know how much light you want to allow it to go in.
content.trans: 对，这很有趣，因为你可以玩转镜头，比如对焦，还可以控制进光量。

content.text: And there's a lot of really you know sometimes a little bit difficult things that not many people understand.
content.trans: 有很多有时候有点难懂的东西，不是每个人都明白。

content.text: Exactly. And so I think that's why it's good to do some research before you buy one because there's so many differences across the different cameras.
content.trans: 没错。所以我觉得买之前做点研究很有必要，因为不同相机之间差别很大。

content.text: Okay. Now both on digital SLRs and on point and shoot cameras, you have something that's called a display panel.
content.trans: 好的。现在无论是用数码单反相机还是傻瓜相机，都有一个叫做显示面板的东西。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: So a display panel is usually covered in plastic and it's the area that tells you how many pictures you've taken, how many pictures you can take.
content.trans: 显示屏通常覆盖着塑料，它告诉你拍了多少张，还能拍多少张。

content.text: If the flash is on, if you're doing an automatic setting.
content.trans: 闪光灯是否开启，是否在用自动模式。

content.text: So it's like the little computer monitor that tells you what's going on with the camera.
content.trans: 它就像个小电脑显示器，告诉你相机的状态。

content.text: Usually after you take a picture, you can also see how it came out right in that moment.
content.trans: 通常你拍完照后，也能立刻在上面看到拍出来的效果。

content.text: Exactly. And so a lot of times with these fancy cameras, you want to know how big the display panel is and how good the quality is in the display panel.
content.trans: 正是。所以对于这些高级相机，你通常想知道显示屏有多大，质量有多好。

content.text: Because obviously if you take a picture and it shows up bad in the display panel, you want to take a new one.
content.trans: 因为如果你拍了张照片，在显示屏上看着很差，你会想重拍一张。

content.text: Right. But what if it's the display panel that's broken?
content.trans: 对。但如果是显示屏本身坏了呢？

content.text: Right. Right. Okay. Very good.
content.trans: 好吧，好吧。很好。

content.text: And that's actually one of the great advantages of digital cameras that you can actually see how your picture looks like.
content.trans: 这实际上是数码相机的一大优势，你可以实时看到照片的样子。

content.text: Exactly.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: In that moment.
content.trans: 在那个瞬间。

content.text: Instancy gratification.
content.trans: 即时满足感。

content.text: Nice. All right. Now when she was looking to buy this digital SLR, she mentioned something about a kit lens.
content.trans: 很好。当她想买这台数码单反时，她提到了 kit lens（套机镜头）。

content.text: Okay. This is fancy camera terminology, right?
content.trans: 好的。这是高级相机术语，对吧？

content.text: Because if you buy a point and shoot, there's no lens. It's just the camera.
content.trans: 因为如果你买傻瓜相机，没有（单独的）镜头，就是个相机。

content.text: But if you're buying a fancy digital SLR, you can buy the body, which means the machine.
content.trans: 但如果你买高级的数码单反，你可以只买 body（机身），也就是机器本身。

content.text: But there's no lens. So normally people will sell, stores will sell cameras with a kit lens.
content.trans: 但没有镜头。所以通常商店卖相机时会配一个套机镜头。

content.text: That means they make a kit or they make a combination for you.
content.trans: 意思是他们为你做了一个套装或组合。

content.text: So it's the body and the lens.
content.trans: 也就是机身加镜头。

content.text: Exactly. But if you want, you can buy the body and the lens separate.
content.trans: 没错。但如果你愿意，你也可以分开买机身和镜头。

content.text: Maybe you want a really fancy lens.
content.trans: 也许你想要个非常高级的镜头。

content.text: Exactly. So what's the kind of fancy lens we might buy?
content.trans: 正是。那我们可能会买什么样的高级镜头？

content.text: A telephoto lens.
content.trans: 单反相机镜头。

content.text: Ooh. So these are the really big lenses for super close-up shots from a distance, right?
content.trans: 噢。这就是那种可以在很远的地方拍特写的大镜头，对吧？

content.text: So you think of maybe professional photographers or photojournalists who have these kind of lenses.
content.trans: 比如专业摄影师或摄影记者就有这种镜头。

content.text: They're big and they're bulky and they're not for traveling.
content.trans: 它们又大又笨重（bulky），不适合旅行。

content.text: Usually you see them in sporting events, right? They're on the side of the field.
content.trans: 通常你在体育赛事中能看到，对吧？他们在场边。

content.text: And they have these big white, usually white lenses on their cameras.
content.trans: 他们的相机上装着白色的大镜头，通常是白色的。

content.text: So you can actually take a very close picture of the action that's far away.
content.trans: 所以你可以拍到远处动作的特写。

content.text: Exactly. And it's really good for those kind of things where you have action or where you're trying to get close-ups.
content.trans: 没错。对于动作场面或你想拍特写时，这非常有用。

content.text: And now if one of these accessories that could go well with a telephoto lens or any digital SLR is a polarizing filter.
content.trans: 现在，如果这些与长焦镜头或任何数码单反相机相配的配件是偏振镜。

content.text: Okay. So filter is something that takes certain elements out of something else.
content.trans: 好的。Filter（过滤器）就是从某物中去除某些元素的东西。

content.text: So we can filter coffee, for example, and it takes the coffee grounds out and leaves the water.
content.trans: 比如过滤咖啡，去掉咖啡渣，留下咖啡液。

content.text: But in a camera, a polarizing filter is something we put onto the glass of the lens to change the way that light goes into the lens.
content.trans: 但在相机上，偏振镜是我们装在镜头玻璃前面，用来改变光线进入镜头方式的东西。

content.text: Okay. So in this way you take a picture of a very sunny day and it will look differently if you didn't have this filter.
content.trans: 好的。所以这样你在大晴天拍照，效果会和你不用滤镜时不一样。

content.text: Exactly. And you can also have a UV filter, which does similar things with UV rays in the sunlight.
content.trans: 没错。你还可以用 UV 镜（紫外线滤镜），它对阳光中的紫外线有类似作用。

content.text: And these are just filters or things you put on the camera and polarizing means that you're splitting up the kind of light that goes in.
content.trans: 这些都是滤镜，装在相机上的，偏振意味着你过滤了进入的光线种类。

content.text: Okay. Very good. Very technical terms.
content.trans: 好的。非常好。非常专业的术语。

content.text: But they're very useful, especially if you're looking to buy one of these cameras and you're not very familiar with the terms.
content.trans: 但它们很有用，特别是当你想买这种相机但不熟悉术语时。

content.text: But why don't we move on now to some very interesting phrases that we saw in the dialogue on Fluency Builder?

content.text: All right. So on Fluency Builder, our first phrase today is entry level. What's an entry level digital SLR?

content.text: Okay. Well, entry level is something that we can use for any kind of purchase, so any kind of thing that we buy.

content.text: In the case of a camera, an entry level is not for an expert or professional.
content.trans: 就相机而言，入门级不是给专家或专业人士用的。

content.text: It's something for someone who's buying one for the first time.
content.trans: 是给第一次购买的人用的。

content.text: Like for beginners.
content.trans: 比如初学者。

content.text: For beginners. So entry level is like entry, beginning, starting.
content.trans: 对于初学者来说。入门就是入门、开始、起步。

content.text: We can have an entry level job where you don't need training or experience.
content.trans: 我们可以有一份入门级工作，不需要培训或经验。

content.text: Okay.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: An entry level camera where you don't need long experience with fancy cameras.
content.trans: 入门级相机，你不需要有使用高级相机的长期经验。

content.text: Or training to know how to use it.
content.trans: 或者经过培训才知道怎么用。

content.text: Okay. Very good. So that's an entry level camera.
content.trans: 好的。很好。这就是入门级相机。

content.text: But as you mentioned, we can also use it for the job, an entry level job position.
content.trans: 但正如你提到的，我们也可以用在工作上，入门级职位。

content.text: All right. What about our second phrase?
content.trans: 好的。那第二个短语呢？

content.text: Okay. So this one goes with the telephoto lens.
content.trans: 好的。这个是跟长焦镜头有关的。

content.text: So lens, right? She says, I don't need a telephoto lens.
content.trans: 镜头，对吧？她说，我不需要长焦镜头。

content.text: My husband doesn't need a telephoto lens.
content.trans: 我丈夫不需要长焦镜头。

content.text: It's not like he's going to be stalking celebrities.
content.trans: 他又不会去跟踪明星。

content.text: Okay. So we have this verb here to stalk.
content.trans: 好的。这里有个动词 stalk（跟踪）。

content.text: To stalk. That means to follow someone around.
content.trans: 跟踪。意思是到处跟着某人。

content.text: Okay.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: And to look at them and to watch them and to not leave them alone.
content.trans: 看着他们，监视他们，不让他们独处。

content.text: Now, as you mentioned this, because this is a very interesting and closely associated topic with photographers.
content.trans: 你提到这个，是因为这是个非常有趣的话题，跟摄影师密切相关。

content.text: You know, you have the paparazzi who follow celebrities and they have these big telephoto lens
content.trans: 你知道，狗仔队会跟踪明星，他们有那种大的长焦镜头，

content.text: so they can take pictures of celebrities without them knowing.
content.trans: 所以他们可以在明星不知情的情况下拍照。

content.text: Exactly. And so you imagine someone in a tree with a big telephoto lens taking a photo of someone famous
content.trans: 没错。你可以想象有人躲在树上，用大长焦镜头拍名人，

content.text: who's half a mile away.
content.trans: 那个人可能在半英里之外。

content.text: And stalking celebrities is something that's a bad thing, right?
content.trans: 跟踪明星是一件坏事，对吧？

content.text: Yeah, it's bad.
content.trans: 是的，不好。

content.text: And also illegal, I think.
content.trans: 而且我觉得是违法的。

content.text: And I think it's illegal.
content.trans: 我也觉得是违法的。

content.trans: 好的。那最后一个短语呢？

content.text: Would you look at that?

content.text: Well, he said it in a very surprised tone, right?
content.trans: 他说的时候语气很惊讶，对吧？

content.text: Kind of like he didn't really expect to find the polarizing filters.

content.text: Oh, wow. I'm surprised.

content.text: Right.
content.trans: 对。

content.text: Right.
content.trans: 没错。
